finding: Run 1 (N=50/model, identical seeds, customer-sim-v1): at identical task satisfaction (39/50 both), sft7b-B3 searched before full constraint discovery in 52% of sessions vs rl7b-B3's 36%, drawing 48% vs 34% customer-correction rates and median 6 vs 4 turns to goal understanding. Failed sessions attribute to EXCESSIVE_FRICTION (agreement with simulator hidden reasons: 1.0, n=21).

mixture.note: rehearsal mixed at training time via run_sft_v2 --rehearsal (H3-proven ratio)

expected_effect: reduced premature-search and customer-correction rates on constraint-discovery scenarios at unchanged task satisfaction and safety
regression_risks: general-chat retention loss (guarded by rehearsal mix)
